title: The Sabbatical Year and the Jubilee Year
description: On Mount Sinai the Lord gives Moses instructions that the land must observe a Sabbath every seventh year, and about the fiftieth year which is to be a Jubilee year. On the Jubilee year the horn shall sound on the Day of Atonement, liberty shall be proclaimed throughout the land, each man shall return to his property and family, and Israelites who have sold themselves as servants shall be set free. The chapter also sets out rules for redeeming land and houses, forbids charging interest from a poor brother, and reminds that the land belongs to the Lord and that the children of Israel are His servants whom He brought out of Egypt.
